problems.summary: Pydantic field bounds must admit at least one value.
problems.harm: Contradictory literal constraints reject every field value, including integer intervals with no integer member.
exclusions: Only plain direct module-level BaseModel subclasses and built-in int, float, str and list fields are inspected.
Bounds must be finite literals; int and length bounds must be integers, and float bounds must convert exactly.
Unknown metadata, nullable types, repeated bound names, methods, dynamic namespaces and generated files are excluded.
No autofix chooses a domain or changes validation behavior.

problems.summary: Pydantic field decorators must target declared fields.
problems.harm: A field validator or serializer naming a missing field prevents the model from being constructed.
exclusions: Only direct module-level BaseModel subclasses with a static namespace and resolved field decorators are inspected.
Unknown inheritance, computed fields, custom decorators, overwritten methods, wildcard fields and uncertain check_fields are excluded.
One diagnostic is emitted per decorator even if several field targets are missing.

problems.summary: Pydantic alias configuration must retain a validation path.
problems.harm: Explicitly disabling validation by both alias and field name prevents model construction.
exclusions: Requires a project dependency whose Pydantic lower bound is at least 2.11.
Only plain direct module-level BaseModel subclasses and literal model_config declarations are inspected.
Class keywords, duplicate keys, config mutation, unpacking, unknown factories and generated source are excluded.

Independent judge verified all11 corpus digests and repeated findings, and requested relative/conditional import exclusions and annotation-effect checks. Added evaluated/quoted annotation and import-replacement regressions.

Independent 153 Python cases, 46 Zod cases and 12 final edge probes passed. Repaired relative/conditional builtin import shadowing and abstained on inexact or nonfinite float-bound conversion; exact integer arithmetic remains supported. Approved three new correctness errors, existing Zod error extension and warning-level Any repair. Merge is gated on exact final full verification.

verification.privateCorpusPolicy: Private identities, revisions, roots, snippets and digests remain in owner-only overlays; published counts are aggregate.
verification.corpusProtocol: Fresh linter process per repository and batch, at most250 files; content digests verified before and after evaluation. Public installed sources are copied to avoid generated-path exclusions. TypeScript corpus ignores inline ESLint configuration so uninstalled foreign rule directives cannot affect the selected AST evaluation; native integration tests verify rule interactions.

corpora.precisionLimit: Zero natural matches do not establish natural-code precision. Narrow scope is supported by labeled native fixtures, independent runtime probes and explicit abstentions.

verification.timingLimitations: Three fresh-process passes per mode, with OS caches unflushed and concurrent verification load. Python selected shipped controls are prefer-str-enum and invalid-pydantic-field-default; TypeScript control is upstream zod/no-conflicting-checks. These are selected normal-engine comparisons, not full-registry or fleet guarantees. Measurements precede the final two conservative provenance/numeric exclusions and precedence lookup refactor; final semantic probes verify those refinements. No optimization claim.
reproducePublicChecks: uv run --project packages/standards --frozen code-standards --root . maintain rules changes --before origin/main --after HEAD

fullRegistrySeedTiming.limitations: Eight independently authored public seed files only. supplementalReview.counterexamples: Runtime reproductions showed globals/builtin replacement, bound setters and escaped module-member code mutation can invalidate lexical import assumptions. File-level abstention and regression cases preserve those valid dynamic contracts.
supplementalReview.warningPrecedence: A SARJ491 warning does not suppress an existing SARJ400 error on the same field.
supplementalReview.independentCliEvidence: Metadata/native warnings exit0. Overlapping SARJ491 warning retains SARJ400 error, exits1 and records only SARJ400 in the blocking baseline.
supplementalReview.scope: No remaining concrete false positive found within the inspected static scope. Arbitrary external mutation and runtime hooks remain outside the finite proof.
supplementalReview.crossAliasRepair: Nested canonical namespace imports are rejected by syntactic origin, including class-local aliases absent from the module import index. Qualified positives remain detectable.
